Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That is all we have from this wonderful match of cricket. The series now moves to the third and final ODI. The last ODI will be played on 26th September at 10:05 am Local (12:05 am GMT). Do join us for the same! Till then, take care and goodbye!

Meg Lanning, the Australia Women skipper, says that they lost early wickets and credits the Indian bowlers for that. Adds that they have great depth in their team and it helps the cause. Says that India played really well for the majority of the game but she is happy with this win. Signs off by saying that it was certainly the most eventful game that they have been a part of and they are expecting the last game to be a really good contest.

Mithali Raj, the skipper of India Women, says that it was a great game of cricket as almost 550 runs were scored. Credits the Australian team for how they played and adds that they really played well in this match. Adds that they are looking forward to playing the last game and also informs that they won't be treating it as a dead rubber. Says that the batting unit has done well, especially Smriti Mandhana and Richa Ghosh. Signs off by saying that she was not expecting the last ball to be a no ball but it is part and parcel of the game.

No prizes for guessing! Beth Mooney is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. She starts by giving credit to Carey for the way she batted. Adds that she did have the best of time in the pre-season and the support staff has been quite supportive to her. Signs off by saying that she enjoyed her time out in the middle.

NEVER GIVE UP! That seems to be the mantra by which any Australian plays this great game of cricket and this match was an exhibition of just that. They lost 4 wickets very early and it seemed like we were headed for an early finish. But, Beth Mooney took the responsibility on her shoulders and put on a stunning display of ODI batting. She was first joined by Tahlia McGrath, who played a brilliant knock of 74 runs to make sure that the Aussies are in the hunt. After the departure of Tahlia McGrath, it was time for Nicola Carey. She joined Mooney to take the game deep. Mooney got to her ton and she along with Carey got the hosts over the line in what was a very dramatic final over. It was some brilliant batting by Beth Mooney and useful contributions by Tahlia McGrath and Nicola Carey that made sure that the Aussies won on the last ball of the game!

India Women would be heartbroken with that loss. They started brilliantly, bowled well in the middle phases and were in the game till the last ball but could not get through. Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh, Pooja Vastrakar and Deepti Sharma took 1 wicket each and bowled well throughout the game. They kept the Aussies under pressure till the last over but would be disappointed with how that last over played out. From jubilation, it was dejection in their camp and they will be heartbroken.

Oh, how the scenes have changed! Before the no ball was called, the Indian camp was over the moon with their celebration but now, Australia Women are celebrating! They have continued their winning streak and this win has been nothing short of sensational. Take a bow, Beth Mooney! Heartbreak for India Women as they had the game in their control till the very end but have lost it. The dejected faces say it all.

OH MY WORD! OH MY WORD! OH MY WORD! WHAT DID WE JUST SEE? So much drama, so, so much drama in the last few overs. Oh let me catch my breath! The Aussies have done it! It seemed unlikely but they have done it in the end. An incredible win for them and their winning streak continues. Full ball, on middle. Nicola Carey heaves it to wide of Jemimah Rodrigues at long on. Jemimah runs to her left, collects the ball and throws it to Jhulan Goswami at the non-striker's end. She cannot stop the batters from taking two runs. Australia Women win by 5 wickets!!

The umpires now are having a chat with the players. They are clarifying how many runs are needed off the last ball. After the catch was taken, Nicola Carey did not complete the run so 2 will be needed off the Free Hit!

TAKEN! NO BALL! What is happening out there? A high full toss, on off. Carey hits it to mid-wicket and the catch is taken. Indian players start celebrating but the umpires want to check if it was a no ball as the ball seems just over the waist. The replays roll in and the TV umpire calls it a no ball. Carey was standing a bit deep in the crease but it still looks quite high. So, the last ball is a FREE HIT!

Is that a no ball? It is a high full toss and the catch of Nicola Carey has been taken. Ooohh, this looks close. This is indeed very close. If it is a legal delivery, then the game is over as the catch has been taken. Tell you what, I would not want to be a TV umpire at this moment. NO BALL! I repeat, it is a NO BALL!
A couple more! 3 needed from the last ball now! Full ball, on leg. Nicola Carey heaves it towards wide long on and a slight fumble allows the second!
Just a leg bye! Full ball, on off. Beth Mooney gets it from her pads while looking to paddle. It goes only as far as the keeper. Richa Ghosh goes to her right and keeps it to one. 5 from 2 now!

Just the bye! Goswami bowls the yorker, around leg. Nicola Carey misses the flick after backing away to the leg side. The batters set off for the bye. The keeper misses the shy at her end. 6 from 3 now!
The Aussie physio is out as a part of the concussion protocol. Nicola Carey has been hit on the helmet by a beamer from Jhulan Goswami.

NO BALL! That must have slipped out of her hands! Jhulan Goswami goes for the yorker but the ball slips out of her hands and she ends up bowling a high full toss. It is so high that it hits Nicola Carey directly on the helmet. So, the next ball will be a Free Hit!
Another fumble! Full ball, on the pads. Whipped towards deep mid-wicket. The batters run for the second and the throw to the bowler is a good one but Jhulan Goswami does not collect it. 8 from 4 now!

Sloopy work by Richa Ghosh! Low full toss, on the pads. Mooney heaves it to deep mid-wicket. The batters go for the second, the throw comes to the keeper. Ghosh moves forward to collect and then has a shy at her end but misses. The batters take the third run too!
Right then. 13 from the last over. Who will bowl? Mithali Raj goes back to Jhulan Goswami to bowl the last over.
Tossed up, down leg. Beth Mooney works it behind square on the leg side towards Jhulan Goswami. A single taken!

In the air..but it lands just in front of Jemimah Rodrigues at deep mid-wicket. Tossed up, around off. Beth Mooney slog-sweeps it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. Jemimah Rodrigues dives forward to take the catch but it lands just in front of her. They take a couple.
Tossed up, on off. Nicola Carey works it to long off for one.

In the air...but it lands safely! Flatter ball, outside off. Beth Mooney shuffles across and looks to hoick it on the leg side. But it goes off the top edge towards Poonam Yadav at short third man. The batters take a run.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Tossed up, around off. Beth Mooney makes room on and creams this one through covers for a boundary.
Leg bye! Tossed up, outside off. Nicola Carey shuffles across to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The LBW appeal is turned down. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls away.
This is going down to the wire! 23 needed from 12. Rajeshwari Gayakwad will bowl the penultimate over.
FOUR! Just what the Aussies wanted! A boundary to end the over! Short ball, down leg. Beth Mooney works it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Floated, around off. Beth Mooney looks to slog sweep but she gets an inside edge onto her pads.
JUST SHORT! Tossed up, on off. Beth Mooney shimmies down and hits it to Deepti Sharma at cover who dives but the ball does not carry. The batters take a couple.
Short ball, down leg. Beth Mooney hangs back and pulls it behind square for a couple.
Flighted ball, on middle. Nicola Carey plays the reverse slap to long off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Beth Mooney skips down and pushes it to long off for a run.
Just a couple of runs! Full ball, on off. Nicola Carey plays the reverse sweep over covers for a couple.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Beth Mooney squeezes it to sweeper cover for one.
Loopy and full ball, on off. Beth Mooney hits it back to the bowler.
Wide! Too wide, outside off. Beth Mooney leaves it alone. Wided!

NOT OUT! Flighted ball, on off. Beth Mooney works it to long off and scampers through for the second run. Deepti Sharma fails to collect the ball while taking the bails off and the TV umpire adjudges Carey as not out.
Is that a run out? Well, Nicola Carey is short but Deepti Sharma loses the ball while taking the bails off. This will be not out.
Floated, around off. Beth Mooney skips down and slices it past point for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on off. Punched towards mid on for nothing.
Tossed up, outside off. Carey drives it hard but straight towards cover.

Beth Mooney brings up her hundred! What an innings this has been from Mooney! She does not celebrate, acknowledges the applause from her teammates and the Aussie fans in the crowd as she knows that the job is not done yet! Tossed up, on off. Beth Mooney works it down the ground for one.
Tossed up, on off. Nicola Carey plays the same shot again but it goes straight to the point fielder this time. A single taken.
Flatter ball, on middle. Nicola Carey plays the switch hit over cover for a couple of runs.
Another short ball, outside off. Nicola Carey cuts hard but finds the point fielder.
Short ball, down leg. Beth Mooney pulls it towards deep square leg for a run and moves to 99.
Poonam Yadav (4-0-23-0) is back on.
Loopy ball, around off. Carey drills it straight down the ground. The fielder gets across but a fumble allows the second.
Stumping missed! Tossed up, outside off. Carey misses the drive and steps out of her crease. Richa Ghosh fumbles to collect and Carey comes back in.
Beth Mooney moves to 98 with a single down to long off.
Just a single there and the Australia Women batters are under pressure! Tossed up, outside off. Carey hits it straight towards long off for one.
Full ball, on the pads. Mooney works it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Carey comes down the track so Sharma pushes it wide outside off. This is hit down to long off for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Carey cuts it hard. The fielder at point dives and keeps it to one.
Sloopy work! Shorter ball, down the leg side. Mooney hits it straight to short fine leg. The throw comes in and a fumble by Rajeshwari Gayakwad allows the batters to take the second.
Shorter ball, on off. Mooney comes down the track and works it wide of long on for a couple.
Just a single as this is drilled to long off.
Another dot! Tossed up, outside off. Carey drives it but straight towards cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to point.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes back to bowl.
Change.
Tossed up, outside off. Carey comes down the track and smacks it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off; Mooney drags it towards mid on for a quick single.
Short again and cut away to covers for one again.
Just short of the fielder! Shorter ball, outside off. Mooney cuts it in the air. The fielder at point dives but the ball lands just short of her dive. A single is taken.
Full ball, way outside off. Left alone and wide called.
Two more and that is really good running! Tossed up, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
Loopy ball, around off. Driven to long off for one.
FOUR! Classy shot and that makes it 13 from that over! Length ball, on the pads. Mooney whips it over square leg for a boundary.
A perfect yorker, on off. All that Mooney can do is block it out.
Length ball, around off. Beth Mooney tries to play the same shot but misses.

FOUR! Oh, that is so clever! Full ball, outside off. Beth Mooney shuffles across looking to paddle but at the last moment, she plays the reverse paddle. The ball goes over short third man for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Punched to long off for one.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Carey! Pooja Vastrakar bowls a full one, on the pads. Carey sends the ball racing to the fine leg fence with ease.
Loopy ball, on off. Nicola Carey digs it out to cover-point for one.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Beth Mooney punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A tad short, outside off. Nicola Carey taps it towards point. Pooja Vastrakar there fumbles and the batters take a run.
Flatter ball, on off. Beth Mooney punches it to sweeper cover and collects a single.
FOUR! A very crucial boundary for Beth Mooney and Australia Women. Tossed up, on off. Mooney advances down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter ball, on off. Nicola Carey rocks back and punches it down the ground for one.
Length ball, on middle. Nicola Carey turns it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 87 runs needed from 60 balls.
In the blockhole, around off. Nicola Carey digs it out to cover.
Back of a length, around off. Nicola Carey taps it to cover.
Full ball, on the pads. Nicola Carey clips it towards fine leg for a couple.
Full ball, on off. Nicola Carey drives it back to the bowler.
Full ball, outside off. Beth Mooney drives it to Deepti Sharma at cover. She fails to stop the ball cleanly and concedes a run.
Pooja Vastrakar (6-0-26-1) is back on.
FOUR! Another short ball, outside off. Nicola Carey cuts hard but it goes of the outside edge and it beats the short third man fielder and into the fence. 91 runs needed from 66 balls.
Short and wide. Nicola Carey looks to cut but misses.
Short ball, outside off. Nicola Carey stays back and cuts it late past point for a couple of runs. The fielder gives it a chase and saves two runs for her side.
Nicola Carey walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma provides her team the much-needed breakthrough and India Women are back in this game! Sharma serves a quicker ball, on the pads. Tahlia McGrath whips it off her pads behind square on the leg side. She hits it straight to Yastika Bhatia at short fine leg who makes no mistake. Australia Women are 5 down now and it is GAME ON!
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

In the blockhole, around middle. Beth Mooney digs it out.
Flighted ball, on middle. Tahlia McGrath turns it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up nicely, around off. Beth Mooney presses forward to defend but it goes off the outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
Floated, around middle. Beth Mooney turns it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, on off. Beth Mooney defends it off the back foot.
Tossed up, on off. Mooney blocks it out.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Beth Mooney stays back to cut but she gets an outside edge and the ball goes towards third man. Smriti Mandhana gives it a chase and keeps it down to two.
Length ball, on off. Tahlia McGrath defends it out.
Tahlia McGrath walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pooja Vastrakar strikes this time and Australia Women lose their fourth wicket! Good-length ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to drive on the up but it takes the outside edge and the ball goes straight to Yastika Bhatia at first slip who makes no mistake this time.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on middle. Beth Mooney looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge towards mid-wicket. A single taken!
Length ball, around off. Beth Mooney defends it towards cover.
Full ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner drives it through covers to collect a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to punch it through covers but she misses.
Ashleigh Gardner comes down the track and pushes it to mid off for one.
Flatter ball, around leg. Blocked out.
FOUR! Top shot and that is a much-needed boundary for the Aussies! Tossed up, on off. Ashleigh Gardner comes down the track and hits it over mid off for a boundary.
Shorter ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner rocks back and pushes it to point.
Tossed up, on off. Beth Mooney comes down the track and drives it to mid off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.

Drinks break! India Women are clearly bossing the game right now and the Aussies have been put on the back foot, courtesy of some excellent bowling from Jhulan Goswami and Meghna Singh up front. India Women have come out with intent on the field and they are making things harder for the hosts.
Play and a miss! Singh serves a full one, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to break the shackles and goes for the booming drive. But she only connects with the thin air around her bat.
Another defensive push towards covers.
On a length, around off. Ashleigh Gardner stays in the crease and blocks it out.
Full ball, on the pads. Worked to deep square leg for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to covers for one.
Short ball, around leg. Ashleigh Gardner misses the pull.
Tossed up, on off. Tapped towards cover for a quick single.
Ashleigh Gardner cuts this short ball hard, but straight towards cover.
Flatter ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner misses the cut shot.
Tossed up, on off. Mooney pushes it to long on for one.
Darted on the pads. Tucked towards mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, around off. Pushed to covers by Mooney.
Fuller ball, on leg. Driven to mid on.
Length ball, around off. Blocked out.

FOUR! Ashleigh Gardner survives! Length ball, on off. She gets the outside edge while looking to block. The ball goes low towards first slip, but the fielder does not get down in time and the ball races to the fence.
Fuller ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner misses the drive.
Length ball, around off. Ashleigh Gardner is beaten while looking to block.
Length ball, on leg. Mooney gets it off the inside edge towards short fine leg for one.
Flatter ball, around off. Ashleigh Gardner pushes it to point.
Fuller ball, on off. Blocked out.
Darted on middle. Pushed to long on for one.
Flatter ball, around off. Mooney rocks back and blocks it.
Tossed up, on off. Blocked out.
Shorter ball, around off. Punched to covers.
That ends Powerplay 1. A change in bowling as Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes in the attack.
Good-length ball, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to poke at it but she misses.
Length ball, on off. Ashleigh Gardner defends it out.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is some fantastic piece of fielding from Pooja Vastrakar and India Women are delighted as they get to see the back of Ellyse Perry. Length ball, on off. Beth Mooney taps it to cover and looks for a run. Pooja Vastrakar comes running in from cover. She collects the ball cleanly and under-arms it to hit the stumps at the striker's end. Ellyse Perry is well short of her crease and she has to walk back. India Women are well and truly on top now! Ashleigh Gardner walks out to bat.
Is that a run out? Ellyse Perry is already walking! Yup, she is out for sure.
FOUR! SHOT! Short ball, around off. Beth Mooney hangs back and pulls it in front of square for a boundary.
Good-length ball, around off. Beth Mooney taps it towards backward point.
Length ball, around off. Beth Mooney drives it back to the bowler.
Length ball, on off. Beth Mooney pushes it to mid on and takes a quick run. Good running between the wickets!
FOUR! HAMMERED! Short ball, around off. Beth Mooney rocks back, picks up the length early, and pulls in front of square for a boundary.
Length ball, around middle. Beth Mooney pushes it to mid on.
Banged in short, outside off. Perry swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Perry hangs back to defend but she gets beaten as the ball jags back in sharply and hits her high on the pads.
Good-length ball, on off. Perry blocks it off the back foot.
Length ball, jagging back in just that little bit, from off. Beth Mooney defends it off the front foot.
Wide! Too wide, outside off. Beth Mooney stays back and leaves it alone. Wided!
Another length ball, on off. Beth Mooney comes forward to block it.
Length ball, on middle. Beth Mooney presses forward to block this one out.
Length ball, jagging back in from middle. Beth Mooney defends it out.
Wide! Too full and wide. Beth Mooney lets it be. The umpire calls it a wide.
FOUR! Length ball, on the pads. Beth Mooney stays back and tickles it to fine leg for a boundary.
Short ball, around off. Ellyse Perry mistimes the pull and the ball lobs up in the air behind square on the leg side. They take one.
BEAUTY! Good-length ball, landing on off pole and shaping away. Beth Mooney pokes at it but gets beaten as the ball whistles past her outside edge.
Wide! Goswami spills this one down leg. Beth Mooney misses the flick. Wide called.
FOUR! SHOT! Length ball, around off. Beth Mooney comes forward and carves this one through covers for a boundary. A welcome boundary for Australia Women.
A bumper, outside off from Goswami. Beth Mooney ducks under it watchfully.
Leg bye! Length ball, strayed on the pads. Perry misses the flick and it tickles her pads towards fine leg. They take a leg bye!
Length ball, angling in from off. Ellyse Perry drives it back to the bowler.
Length ball, around off. Ellyse Perry blocks it to mid off.
Full ball, around leg. Mooney misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Ellyse Perry walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch! India Women are on fire! Australia Women are in trouble as they lose their skipper. Short ball, around off. Meg Lanning mistimes the pull in the air towards deep square leg. Rajeshwari Gayakwad runs to her right and takes a fantastic low catch, diving to her right.
Commentary.Howout: c Rajeshwari Gayakwad b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED! Good-length ball, on middle and leg. Beth Mooney miscues the pull and the ball goes towards Poonam Yadav at mid-wicket who drops it. The batters take a run.
Good-length ball, around off. Meg Lanning guides it towards third man for a run.
Leg bye! An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no. Full ball, angling in from leg. Beth Mooney gets hit on the pads as she misses her flick. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls away.
Length ball, jagging back in from leg. Beth Mooney misses the flick and it clips her pads before going to the keeper.
Full ball, lands on off and comes back in. Jhulan Goswami gets the inside edge towards square leg.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! First boundary for the hosts! Jhulan Goswami bowls it touch fuller, outside off. Lanning leans into it and drives it past covers for a boundary.
Fuller ball, on off. Punched to covers.
Length ball, down the leg side. Wide called.
On a length, on off. Tapped to covers for one.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
BEATEN! Length ball, lands on off and shapes away. Lanning is once again beaten while looking to defend. There is a big appeal for caught behind but turned down.
Length ball, around off. This is nicely blocked by Lanning.
OH MY WORD! How did that miss the stumps? This lands on leg and comes back in with the angle. Lanning looks to drive it but misses. The ball goes just past the leg stump back to the keeper.
Length ball, around off. Blocked out.
Good-length delivery, on off. Lanning presses forward and pushes it towards point.
On a length, around off. Lanning blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Mooney covers the stumps and leaves it.
Length ball, down the leg side. Left alone and called a wide.
Full ball, on the pads. Mooney blocks it with ease now.
Fuller ball, outside off. Left alone.
Length ball, around off. Mooney gets the inside edge back on the pads.
This goes away after landing on off. Mooney looks to block but is beaten.
How do you play that? This lands on off and comes back in sharply. Mooney looks to block but the ball cuts her in half as it goes through the gate.
Full ball, on off. Lanning blocks it out with ease.
On a length, around off. Lanning taps it towards point.
Meghna Singh to bowl from the other end and use the other new ball.
Length ball, outside off. Left alone.
Jaffa! That is the perfect delivery. This lands on a length, on off. Lanning looks to drive but the ball shapes away at the last moment and goes past the outside edge.
Length ball, on off. Blocked out.
That is a brave leave! This lands on off and moves away just a touch. Lanning leaves it and the ball goes past the off pole.
Australia Women are underway! Length ball, around off. Meg Lanning opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for one.
Lovely delivery! Good-length ball, moving away from outside off. Meg Lanning has a poke at it but the ball whizzes past her outside edge.
Length ball, around off. Meg Lanning comes forward to block this one out.
Meg Lanning walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Big, big wicket for India Women and they are pumped! Length ball, lands on off and nips back in. Healy comes forward to block but the ball goes through the gate and hits the off pole! Jhulan Goswami has provided her team with a dream start.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, shaping away outside off. Alyssa Healy looks to poke at it but misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Alyssa Healy cuts it towards cover.
